world_model_delta: Explicit rule: faction memory does not confer territorial title, ownership, or governance standing. Memory of prior holding is useful for pathfinding only. A faction may not cite memory records as evidence of ownership in any dispute — disputes resolve by current score, not history.
validator_question: Is the memory-claim prohibition enforceable from simulation state alone?
risk_of_symbol_smuggling: LOW — explicit prohibition; dispute resolution uses current score
